_comment: Unified seed data for EXERCISE IRON FORGE 26. Single source of truth across the Plan dashboard, Prepare workspace, Task Graph, Task Manager, and ORBAT Manager widgets. Built by merging nato-cax-01plan.html + nato-cax-02prepare.html (the 'populated demo' state shown in the mocks) with plan.json / prepare.json (the 'fresh draft' empty state). This file represents the POPULATED state — i.e. where the project is heading — so every widget has real, matching data to render against. IDs are consistent across all sections: people use the same initials/ids everywhere, workflow task ids match between plan.exerciseCreationWizard, prepare.tasks, prepare.sidenav and the TaskGraph node ids, and ORBAT unit ids match between the unit library and the placed nodes.

task.title: Define & review scenario
task.description: Review strategic context, OPFOR definition, and exercise area narrative

strategicContext.title: The Sorvian Peninsula Crisis
strategicContext.body: The fictional state of Sorvia, bordering the Eastern Flank, has experienced rapid deterioration of the security environment following contested elections and external interference by the Dorvian Federation. NATO has activated Article 4 consultations and deployed a Multinational Division to the region. The exercise begins at D-Day with the division assuming operational control of the assigned area under conditions of a high-intensity conventional threat combined with significant information operations and cyber activity targeting allied C2 nodes.

opforDefinitions.title: Dorvian 3rd Combined Arms Army
opforDefinitions.body: Combined arms force with integrated air defence, EW, and cyber capabilities. Manoeuvre-heavy doctrine with strong ISR and long-range fires. Will challenge BLUFOR across all functional areas simultaneously.

opforDefinitions.title: Asymmetric threat cells
opforDefinitions.body: Proxy forces conducting information operations, sabotage of LOCs, and civilian population influence. Active disinformation campaign targeting NATO public opinion and allied cohesion.

comments.text: OPFOR definition looks solid. Please ensure the cyber element is coordinated with J6 — they flagged that the C2 node targeting should reference specific systems in the scenario.
Updated — referenced SATCOM and primary HF nets as the targeted systems. Also expanded the proxy forces section per the EXDIR guidance.

task.title: Define training audience
task.description: Define who the exercise trains — primary and secondary audiences, nations, and participant numbers
task.approvalNote: Submitted for approval · Awaiting BGen Hartmann

primaryAudience.title: Multinational Division HQ Staff
primaryAudience.body: Full J1–J9 directorate staff from all five participating nations. The primary exercise audience covers all HQ functions including operations, intelligence, logistics, plans, fires, CIMIC, and communications.

secondaryAudiences.title: J3 Operations Branch
secondaryAudiences.body: Operations branch staff with specific focus on battle rhythm, decision cycle, and joint fires integration.

secondaryAudiences.title: J2 Intelligence Branch
secondaryAudiences.body: Intelligence staff exercising INTSUM production, ISR coordination, and intelligence support to operations.

secondaryAudiences.title: J4 Logistics Branch
secondaryAudiences.body: Logistics staff exercising sustainment planning, supply chain management, and logistics synchronisation.

secondaryAudiences.title: J6 Communications
secondaryAudiences.body: Signal and communications staff exercising C2 continuity and PACE plan execution under cyber-degraded conditions.

task.title: Define simulation composition
task.description: Define which simulation systems, C2 nodes, and federation architecture constitute the exercise environment
task.approvalNote: Submitted for approval · Awaiting BGen Hartmann

primaryProtocol.title: Primary federation protocol
primaryProtocol.body: IEEE 1516 High Level Architecture (HLA) — Evolved. All constructive simulation nodes federate via a central RTI. DIS IEEE 1278.1 used for legacy node compatibility. Link 16 / TADIL J for live and virtual tactical data link integration.

topology.title: Federation topology
topology.body: Star topology with central RTI hosted at HQ LANDCOM. National simulation nodes connect via dedicated MPLS links over the NATO Unclassified network. C2 systems connect via standardised NFFI/JC3IEDM data exchange.

supportSystems.title: Terrain server
supportSystems.body: Shared correlated terrain database covering the Sorvian Peninsula AOR. Hosted at central simulation node. Distributed to all federated simulators via HLA terrain services object model.

supportSystems.title: After Action Review system
supportSystems.body: All federation traffic logged via passive HLA logger for post-exercise AAR playback. BML message logging captures all C2 transactions for exercise analysis and lessons learned.

task.title: Define & review PMESII variables
task.description: 5 of 8 domains complete — Political, Military, Economic, Social, Infrastructure
task.approvalNote: Submitted for approval · Awaiting Col Anderssen

domains.value: Government in exile. Contested sovereignty. Regional neighbours divided. UN Security Council deadlocked.
Near-peer OPFOR. Asymmetric threat cells. Friendly forces at 85% readiness. Air domain contested.
Critical infrastructure disrupted. Port operations at 40% capacity. Fuel supply degraded by OPFOR interdiction.
IDPs: ~180,000. Hostile media environment. Pro-Dorvian population 30% in eastern AOR.
Road network degraded in sectors 3–4. 2 bridges destroyed. Rail LOC operational with restrictions.
Draft: Active disinformation campaign. C2 nodes targeted. Needs J6 coordination.

comments.text: Information domain needs J6 input before we can approve. Physical environment and Time domains still empty — please complete before submitting.

objectives.approvalNote: Approved by BGen Hartmann · 1 Jun 2025 · No further action required

trainingObjectives.objective: Exercise HQ battle rhythm and decision cycle under degraded communications
Integrate multinational staff across all functional areas with full interoperability
Conduct joint fires planning and coordination including air-land integration
Execute sustainment planning across a 14-day high-intensity campaign
Respond to cyber incidents affecting C2 nodes and ISR assets
Coordinate CIMIC activities and manage civilian-military interface in AOR
Produce and disseminate intelligence products to support manoeuvre decisions
Conduct media operations and strategic communication under information pressure

task.title: Review and validate MEL/MIL
task.description: 47 injects generated — review for realism, sequencing, and training load balance
task.approvalNote: Submitted for approval · Awaiting Col Anderssen

mel._comment_injects: 8 of the 47 total injects are detailed in the mock; remainder are summarised by category count below to match the original S3 'MEL summary' chip totals (12 INTEL, 9 CYBER, 8 LOG, 18 other).

injects.title: OPFOR crossing of PHASE LINE ODIN detected
injects.body: ISR assets report battalion-sized element crossing in sector 2. Triggers INTSUM and fires request.

injects.title: Cyber attack on HQ communications node
injects.body: Primary C2 link degraded to 30% capacity. Backup PACE plan must be activated within 4 hours.

injects.title: IDP column blocks Route AMBER
injects.body: ~4,200 IDPs moving west on primary supply route. CIMIC and MP coordination required.

injects.title: Weather degradation — reduced air support window
injects.body: Ceiling at 300ft. All CAS sorties cancelled for 18-hour period. Ground-based fires only.

injects.title: OPFOR SOF element identified in rear area
injects.body: HUMINT: 6-person team targeting fuel depot. Counter-SOF response required within 2 hours.

injects.title: Political event — NATO FM emergency session
injects.body: New ROE issued following political decision. Division must implement updated ROE within 6 hours.

injects.title: Logistics crisis — fuel reserves at 15%
injects.body: Resupply convoy delayed 48h. Priority allocation required. Combat power vs sustainment trade-off.

injects.title: OPFOR ceasefire offer — information operation
injects.body: Media reports ceasefire proposal. STRATCOM and legal must respond within 3 hours. Likely IO deception.

orbat._comment_orbatNodes: Nodes currently placed in the ORBAT builder, drawn from the unit library above (unitId links back to unitLibrary[].id). 'level' is the tree depth (0=Corps,1=Div,2=Bde,3=Bn) used for the org-chart layout. 'params' are unit-specific readiness fields filled in via the side panel; an empty {} plus warn:true means the unit was added but parameters haven't been completed yet — exactly as in the mock. 'latlng' is null/absent until the unit is placed on the Positions map tab (none are placed yet in this state, matching 'posUnitCount: 0/6').

_comment_taskGraphNotes: For the TaskGraph/TaskNodeComponent React widgets: map each workflowTasks[] entry above to a TaskNodeData node using id -> node id, assignedTo/approver -> assignee/reviewer (resolve person id to name via 'people'), status -> {approved:'approved', 'in-review':'in-review', pending:'pending'} (no current case maps to 'save' until exercise-area/orbat enter review), and derive 'progress' from sections[id].task or domain completion (e.g. pmesii 5/8 domains = 0.625, mel 0/47 reviewed injects vs total = proportion reviewed). Dependency edges should mirror navTarget order: scenario -> pmesi-variables, scenario -> training-objectives, training-audience -> training-objectives, pmesi-variables -> exercise-area, training-objectives -> exercise-area, training-objectives -> mel-mil, training-audience -> mel-mil, exercise-area -> orbat-positions, mel-mil -> orbat-positions — i.e. identical to the existing data.ts taskEdges, just renamed to match workflowTasks ids 1:1.
_comment_taskManagerNotes: TaskManager.tsx currently renders tactical field tasks (MOCK_TASKS) which are a DIFFERENT concept from workflowTasks above (exercise-prep workflow vs in-exercise tactical taskings generated from MEL/MIL injects). This file does not invent tactical taskings since none exist in either source; if TaskManager should visualise exercise-prep tasks instead, point it at 'workflowTasks' and resolve assignedTo/approver via 'people'. If it should show MEL/MIL-driven tactical taskings once the exercise runs, those will need to be generated per-inject (e.g. one task per sections.mel.injects[] entry, assignee = the responding J-cell) — not present in source mocks and not fabricated here.
